opening.title: Customer Operations and Support Specialist
opening.summary: Be the person customers reach when something needs fixing: resolve tickets, investigate transactions and keep people informed until it is done.
opening.about:
When a customer’s deposit has not shown, a withdrawal is pending or a purchase looks wrong, they need someone who can find out what happened and tell them clearly. That is this role.

You will work in our support console, investigate transactions with the tools we have built, escalate what needs engineering, and write the replies and documentation that make the next case faster.
owns: The support queue: replies, follow-ups and closing cases properly.
First-line transaction investigations, using our admin tools.
Escalations to engineering and finance, with the evidence they need.
responsibilities: Respond to customers clearly and calmly, in plain English.
Investigate deposits, withdrawals and purchases and explain what happened.
Spot patterns in tickets and report them so the cause gets fixed.
Keep notes accurate so anyone can pick up a case where you left it.
requirements: Experience in customer support or operations, ideally where money or orders were involved.
Excellent written English and a calm, respectful tone under pressure.
Careful attention to detail: amounts, references and dates.
Comfort learning internal tools and following a process.
niceToHave: Experience with crypto, wallets or payments.
Experience writing help-centre articles or support macros.
success: In your first month you can resolve the common cases without help.
Customers get a clear answer sooner, and fewer cases are reopened.
Recurring problems reach engineering with evidence attached.

questions.label: A customer’s transaction is still unresolved after a day and they are upset. How would you handle it?
